description: Reusable agent workflows for operating project harness templates.

interface.longDescription: Project Lifecycle Lab packages reusable Codex operating knowledge for project harness templates. The harness runtime stays in the repo: project state, scripts, validators, and generated governance docs remain inspectable and local. Repo-scoped skills under .agents/skills stay canonical until plugin distribution is ready.
